measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on quantifying ethical risks in pathology foundation models, specifically privacy leakage of patient attributes (age, gender, race), clinical reliability under distribution shifts, and group fairness across demographic and institutional subgroups.
